# Global Gas Emissions by Country - 1950-2024

The goal of this project is to apply linear regression to this dataset.  

## Link to File:  
https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/lucalullo/global-ghg-gas-emissions-by-country-1950-2024/data

## About the Data
Country-level panel dataset of greenhouse gas emissions and emissions per capita from 1950 to 2024.  
* **Country**: Country name corresponding to the ISO code  
* **Year**: Year of Observation  
* **iso_code**: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code  
* **total_ghg**: Total greenhouse gas emissions expressed in million tonnes of CO$_2$ equivalent (MtCO$_2$e)  
* **ghg_per_capita**: Greenhouse gas emissions per person expressed in tonnes of CO$_2$ equivalent per capita.
